t: A cloud spreadsheet for collecting, sorting, and charting class data.
steps: Ask your school admin to confirm Workspace for Education access.
Sign in with your school account.
Create a sheet for a class data project.
Share it through Drive or Classroom.
Ask the admin whether Gemini features are on or off for students.
Download a CSV copy if you plan to use CODAP.
Review the sharing settings before students enter data.
